description: This file defines the `SwabbleConfig` struct and related nested structs, which encapsulate configuration settings for the Swabble application, including audio, wake word detection, hooks, logging, transcripts, and speech. It also contains `ConfigError` and `ConfigLoader` enums for handling configuration errors and loading/saving configurations from/to disk.

methods.name: load(at:)
methods.description: Loads the `SwabbleConfig` from a specified URL, or from the default path if none is provided. Throws an error if the configuration file is missing or cannot be decoded.

methods.name: save(_:at:)
methods.description: Serializes and saves the provided `SwabbleConfig` to the specified URL, creating necessary directories. Throws an error if saving fails.
